market.summary: The Nifty ended flat at 22,750, but mid and small caps rallied (Smallcap +2.7%) and about two stocks rose for every one that fell. Brent near $116 and the Fed decision on Wednesday kept the big indices in check; foreign investors are still selling, domestic funds are buying. Media, pharma and consumer durables led, which helped Tips Music and Orient Electric; IT and private banks lagged.

points.text: Nifty 50 closed at 22,749.75 (-0.02%), Sensex 73,598.67; Midcap +1%, Smallcap +2.7%; 2,807 stocks rose and 1,334 fell.
Nifty Media +3.6% (top sector), pharma +1.7%, auto +1.2%; IT -0.8% (Infosys cut its FY27 growth guidance), private banks -0.4%.
Brent near $116 a barrel (close to a six-month high after attacks on Saudi energy sites); the rupee was near 95.1-95.3 per dollar.
Foreign investors sold ₹1,462 Cr on Monday; October outflows are about $4.75 billion and a record $32.6 billion so far this year.
The US Fed announces its decision on Wednesday 28 Oct; markets fear a hawkish signal that lifts US yields and the dollar.

market.watch: The Fed on Wednesday night (IST) and Brent: above $117 or a hawkish Fed would hit small caps, where most of these trades sit.

GROWW.summary: No new filing or company news today. Groww closed at 186.57, its third close below the 188.75 stop (26 Oct 184.48), even on a day when BSE Ltd was again among the Nifty's top gainers - the weakness is in the stock, not the broker group. The plan says exit; the trade is still marked OPEN.

points.text: Close ₹186.57 vs stop ₹188.75 and entry ₹200.80: -1.18R (-7.1%); 21-day EMA 190.28 and 63-day EMA 192.16 are both above the price.
BSE Ltd was among the Nifty 50's top gainers today, so capital-market sentiment was not the drag.
No exchange filing since the 16 Oct call transcript; no bulk or block deals in the last 10 days.

GROWW.watch: Exit per the plan; tell Claude the exit price so the trade is marked CLOSED.

SEJALLTD.summary: Sejal filed its Q2 call transcript this evening; the PDF could not be opened from tonight's check, so its content is not verified here. The stock slipped 1.7% to 868.80 on a day small caps rose 2.7%, so the full position (average 884.13 after today's add at 893.28) is slightly under water but well above the 838.03 stop.

points.text: Earnings call transcript filed 27 Oct, 16:42 IST (content not read tonight).
Nifty Smallcap +2.7% today while Sejal fell: it lagged the bounce on the day of the add.

SEJALLTD.watch: Hold above the 846.50 result-day low; a close under 838.03 is the exit. Open the transcript for capacity and margin guidance.

THELEELA.summary: No new Leela filing or news today. The stock rose 1.8% to 593.25 with the small-cap bounce and stays above the 579.15 result-day low, but is still below the 604.51 entry. The sector backdrop is good (ITC Hotels' strong quarter yesterday; JM Financial's 8 Oct note had a ₹685 target), but nothing new moved it today.

points.text: JM Financial (8 Oct) rates Leela Buy with a ₹685 target (20x, Sep-2027), expecting 15-16% same-store RevPAR growth; it flags slowing room-rate growth as the main risk.

THELEELA.watch: A close back above 604.51 puts the trade in profit; a close under 573.36 is the exit.

INDHOTEL.summary: Indian Hotels rose 2.2% to 812.85, another post-result closing high, with accumulation on the screener; no new filing today. The drift after results is working and the trade is at +0.6R, about 2% below the +1R level where the stop moves to cost.

points.text: Sector: ITC Hotels' Q2 profit rose about 52% to ₹203 Cr, supporting the strong-demand view for luxury hotels.

INDHOTEL.watch: A close above 831.19 (+1R) moves the stop to cost.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: Tips rose 3.4% to 741.60 as the whole Nifty Media index jumped about 3.6%, the day's best sector; there was no company filing or news. The trade is now in profit (+0.2R), with the wide stop at 662.11 unchanged.

points.text: Nifty Media +3.6% today, the top sector (the reports do not name a single trigger).

TIPSMUSIC.watch: A sector-wide move, not company news: watch whether it holds above 727.89 if media cools; +1R is 793.67.

ORIENTELEC.summary: New trade today at 187.44. The Q2 numbers are strong (revenue +25%, profit more than doubled), and consumer durables were among today's gainers. The catch from the call: copper, aluminium and crude-linked costs are not fully passed on yet, so gross margin is under pressure even as EBITDA margin rose.

points.text: Q2 FY27: revenue ₹879 Cr (+25.2%), EBITDA ₹57 Cr (+49.7%, margin 6.5%, +106 bps), PAT ₹27.1 Cr (+124%); profit was 14% lower than Q1's ₹31.5 Cr.
Fans and appliances ₹550 Cr (+24.9%, BLDC fans +26%); lighting & switchgear ₹329 Cr (+25.7%).
Price hikes of 3-6% in Q2 and about 3% more in October cover roughly 80% of the cost rise in fans and 90% in appliances; management aims for double-digit EBITDA margins over 4-6 quarters.

ORIENTELEC.watch: Copper and aluminium prices (margin risk); the stop is 171.27 and the 173.00 result-day low.
